parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region in which the instance resides.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~118703~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The IDs of the instances to which you want to add tags. You can specify up to 51 IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource to which you want to add tags. Set the value to **INSTANCE**, which indicates instances.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags to add. You can specify up to 21 tags.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddosbgp tag-resources --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --resource-id ddosbgp-cn-n6w1r7nz0000 --tag Value=test-value Key=test-key --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
